## What's Changed

- Added an optional real-IP Ping bypass switch in Settings. In TUN mode, ordinary IPv4 and IPv6 ICMP traffic can use the system route while device policies retain priority.
- Kept default, configured, active, and historical FakeIP ranges outside the Ping bypass rule.
- Added configuration validation and settings rollback when changing Ping bypass. Stop the core before changing this setting.
- Fixed SSH MCP timeouts so connection setup, proxy negotiation, SSH authentication, session creation, and command execution share the requested timeout. Timeout messages now identify the failing stage.
- Fixed settings switches displaying the wrong state after a lost save response. The UI reads the saved state back and waits for synchronization when it cannot confirm the result.
- Simplified descriptions in the general settings panel.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ackwrap/ackrun/compare/v1.0.5...v1.0.7
